description: This file contains functions for translating HTML embedded within Markdown documents. It parses Markdown into an AST, identifies HTML blocks and tags, and translates text nodes with a provided translator, handling skip tags appropriately.

methods.name: translateHTMLBlocks
methods.description: Translates HTML blocks within a Markdown document from source to target language.

methods.name: htmlBlockSpan
methods.description: Determines the start and stop positions of an HTML block within source bytes.

methods.name: applyHTMLReplacements
methods.description: Applies a series of HTML replacements to the original body string, sorted by start position.

methods.name: sortHTMLReplacements
methods.description: Sorts the replacement slices in ascending order by start position.

methods.name: translateHTMLBlock
methods.description: Translates the textual content within an HTML segment, respecting skip tags.

methods.name: shouldTranslateHTMLText
methods.description: Determines whether a text node should be translated based on skip depth and content.

methods.name: isSkipTag
methods.description: Checks if an HTML tag is one that should be skipped during translation (e.g., script, style).
